update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.60 - Career rank tracking, configurable mood threshold, bond-efficiency capping, Trackblazer shop value scoring
New --- - Career rank tracking: detects the end-of-career "Career Rank" screen and OCRs the rank tier (e.g. S+, SS, UG) and rating number, surfaced in all run summary formats. - Configurable mood threshold: the minimum mood required before the bot forces a mood-recovery outing is now a setting (Minimum Mood for Training) instead of hardcoded. - Bond-efficiency capping: optionally excludes already-fully-maxed friendship bars from a training's relationship score, redirecting bonding effort toward cards that still benefit from it. - Trackblazer shop value scoring: optionally orders stat-item shop purchases (Scrolls/Manuals) by your Stat Prioritization list instead of buying every stat's Scroll before any stat's Manual.
All toggle-gated features above default to off (or to prior hardcoded behavior), so existing behavior is unchanged unless explicitly enabled.
